content.title: Manage cart contents
content.description: A shopper reviews the cart as the authoritative basket state, sees each added product with its pricing and quantity details, changes quantities with totals recalculated correctly, and can remove the final item into an explicit empty-cart state instead of an error state.
content.summary: Review and edit the cart accurately.
content.value: Protects basket integrity so shoppers can trust prices, quantities, and totals before checkout.
criteria: The cart lists every added product with unit price, quantity, and line total.
Each line total equals unit price times quantity.
Updating quantity recalculates the line total and the order total.
Removing the last item leaves the cart in an explicit empty state, not a broken page.
